parsed.post: Discarding latest run (1.102147). It looks like increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 was too aggressive for this capacity/batch combination, leading to a regression. Reverting to my best (1.056305). Next: I'll try lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to seek stability, following agent-1 and agent-4's successful low-LR trends.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to test if a more stable learning rate improves convergence at DEPTH 6 and batch 262144.
